title: Donut semicircle summary with delta overlaps the arc

complexity.rationale: The root cause is localized and confirmed, but the fix requires new vertical-fit logic and a product decision for summary stacks that cannot fit inside a small semicircle.

summary: A DonutSummary with a delta line can extend into the inner edge of an S2 semicircle donut. The complete summary stack should remain contained within the semicircle hole without overlapping the arc.
symptom: When a semicircle Donut renders a summary value, label, and delta line, the value extends upward into the donut arc. Summary content that fits correctly without the delta can overlap once the third row is added.
rootCause: packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts:43-86 positions semicircle summaries by subtracting an offset based on the rows below the value, but does not reserve the value text's upward ascent. The value uses an alphabetic baseline when either a label or delta is present at packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts:287-299, so the three-line value/label/delta stack extends above the calculated anchor and can cross the inner arc. The width-limit calculation at packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts:305-325 accounts for the stack's vertical geometry when deriving horizontal space, but there is no corresponding vertical containment rule.

comparison.aspect: Summary containment inside the donut hole
comparison.expected: The complete value, label, and delta stack remains within the open area of the semicircle and does not overlap the arc.
comparison.actual: The semicircle anchor accounts for the rows below the value but not the value's ascent, allowing the value to extend into the arc.

comparison.expected: Each variant positions the complete rendered summary stack within its available inner geometry.
comparison.actual: Circle summaries remain centered at `height / 2`, while semicircle summaries use a bottom-derived offset that is incomplete for a three-line stack.

edgeCases.case: Value, label, and positive or negative delta are visible
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: All three rows remain inside the semicircle hole with the intended row spacing.

edgeCases.case: Value and delta are visible without a label
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The two-row stack remains contained and uses the existing value-to-delta spacing.

edgeCases.case: The value is hidden while label and delta remain visible
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The label and delta remain contained without reserving space for the hidden value.

edgeCases.case: XS and other constrained semicircle sizes
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Summary content follows an explicit fallback when the complete stack cannot fit rather than overlapping the arc.

edgeCases.case: Circle donut summary with a delta
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Existing centered circle-summary placement remains unchanged.

crossCutting.notes: The defect is isolated to static S2 DonutSummary mark geometry. S1 does not support the semicircle Donut variant, so there is no equivalent layout path to update.

implementationPlan.change: Update semicircle summary positioning to reserve the complete rendered stack, including the value's upward ascent, and add a vertical-fit fallback for summary content that cannot fit within the inner radius.
Add regression coverage for semicircle value/label/delta positioning, hidden-value combinations, and constrained sizes; assert clearance from the arc rather than only the generated anchor expression.
Add generated-spec or runtime coverage confirming a semicircle summary with a delta remains within the donut's inner geometry.

openQuestions: When the complete summary stack cannot fit inside an XS semicircle, should the implementation reduce typography, suppress the delta, hide the complete summary, or use another fallback?
